tiers.text: C via ctypes is the big step. The arithmetic can be contracted into fused multiply-adds by default; compare with -ffp-contract=off.
Commit before every submit. ./race submit refuses if paircount/ or race.toml has uncommitted changes.

The calibration entry is a numpy cell list that does 200k in a few seconds. Beating it clearly means compiled code (a cell list in C via ctypes runs in about 1.5 s) or far fewer wasted distance evaluations.
